title: Simulation evidence boundary
text: A tutorial-length molecular dynamics trajectory validates a workflow but does not establish convergence or a biological mechanism. Claims require independent replicas, uncertainty estimates and comparison with experiment or validated calculations.
citation: MD Learning Lab, AGENTS.md and README.md

title: Language model numerical boundary
text: The chemistry language model orchestrates retrieval and tools. Quantum energies, forces and molecular dynamics trajectories remain structured outputs of named scientific programs with configurations, units and provenance.
